commentary: Sweden's founding membership in the Ukraine Aggression Tribunal represents a significant strategic commitment with direct security and economic implications. GDP growth recovered modestly in 2024 (0.82%) after the 2023 contraction, providing fiscal stability for tribunal dues. Defence spending has been the fastest-growing budget line (≥2.0% GDP target reached 2024). The cost of tribunal membership (SEK 30-80M/year) is marginal relative to total defence/foreign policy appropriations.
